component-o.description-s: USB Type-C PD 3.1 sink-only controller with an integrated 16 mohm power path (VBUS_IN to PPHV, 7 A), configured by resistor straps on ADCIN1-4 (no firmware, NVM or MCU); 5-20 V PDOs, integrated Rd, OVP / RCP; WQFN-38 (REF) 4 x 6 mm

cfgpins-ao.2c: ADCIN1 = minimum PD voltage. Decoded 1 = 9 V (Table 8-4 p36). With ADCIN2 also 1 the sink asks for 9 V only (Table 8-3 p35: ADCIN1 1 / ADCIN2 1, I2C address 0x21). Built from stocked E96 values: RUP 178 k (RC0402FR-07178KL) / RDOWN 9.53 k (RC0402FR-079K53L) = 0.0508, inside decoded 1's window 0.0229-0.0722 (Table 8-1 p31); TI's own Figure 9-3 pair is 190 k / 9.5 k = 0.0476 (neither value is E96, and 191 k 0402 is out of stock).

cfgpins-ao.3c: ADCIN2 = maximum PD voltage. Decoded 1 = 9 V (Table 8-5 p36). Built from stocked E96 values: RUP 178 k (RC0402FR-07178KL) / RDOWN 9.53 k (RC0402FR-079K53L) = 0.0508, inside decoded 1's window 0.0229-0.0722 (Table 8-1 p31); TI's own Figure 9-3 pair is 190 k / 9.5 k = 0.0476 (neither value is E96, and 191 k 0402 is out of stock).

cfgpins-ao.5c: ADCIN3 = operating current. Decoded 2 with ADCIN4 decoded 1 = 2 A operating / 3 A maximum (Table 8-6 p37); the board draws about 1.75 A at 9 V (7 V x 2 A through the buck). The datasheet prints no resistor pair for decoded 2: 178 k (RC0402FR-07178KL) / 21.5 k (RC0402FR-0721K5L), both E96 and stocked, gives 0.1078 against Table 8-1's decoded-2 window 0.0723-0.1425, target 0.1074 -- derived here, not from a figure.

cfgpins-ao.7c: ADCIN4 = maximum current. Decoded 1 (with ADCIN3 2) = 3 A maximum (Table 8-6 p37). Built from stocked E96 values: RUP 178 k (RC0402FR-07178KL) / RDOWN 9.53 k (RC0402FR-079K53L) = 0.0508, inside decoded 1's window 0.0229-0.0722 (Table 8-1 p31); TI's own Figure 9-3 pair is 190 k / 9.5 k = 0.0476 (neither value is E96, and 191 k 0402 is out of stock).

cfgpins-ao.18c: FAULT_IN: 0 disconnects from the port, 1 keeps the connection (Table 5-1 p5); Hi-Z at reset. Held high on LDO_3V3 so the sink path stays on (Figure 9-3 leaves it to a system net); a system fault signal may drive it low instead.

cfgpins-ao.8c: I2Ct unused (standalone, no host): Table 5-1 p5 'May be grounded if unused'. With a host, 3.3 k pull-ups to LDO_3V3 (Figure 9-3 R1/R2).

cfgpins-ao.26c: RESERVED 26, 27, 36: 'Tie to ground or LDO_3V3' (Table 5-1 p5); Figure 9-3 ties each through 10 k to GND (R9, R10, R?).

cfgpins-ao.32c: VBUS (32, 33) is the internal LDO's input and must be shorted to VBUS_IN (23-25): ROC note 2 p9 'All VBUS and VBUS_IN pins be shorted together'. Its decoupling CVBUS 1-4.7-10 uF, 25 V rating (6.4 p10; Figure 9-3: 4.7 uF + 4 x 0.01 uF).

cfgpins-ao.15c: DRAIN (15, 30 and the DRAIN exposed pad 40) connect to the internal FET's drain: leave unconnected -- 9.4.1.3 p48 'the drain connection pads ... must not be connected to anything and left floating'. Pad 40 is a thermal pad for the footprint only (RthetaJC bottom DRAIN 4.6 C/W).

cfgpins-ao.38c: VIN_3V3: optional system 3.3 V (Figures 9-1/9-2 p41 'System 3.3V (Optional)'); without it the part runs from VBUS through its own LDO (8.3.2 p27, the dead-battery start-up). Keep CVIN_3V3 10 uF (6.4 p9: 5 min / 10 nom, 6.3 V rating). On this board it is left without a supply: the controller is standalone.

cfgpins-ao.6c: CAP_MIS, DBG_ACC, PLUG_FLIP, PLUG_EVENT: open-drain status outputs (Table 5-1 p5), unused here: leave open.

cfgpins-ao.19c: SINK_EN: open-drain, 0 = sink path enabled, 1 = disabled (Table 5-1 p5): an active-low power-good for the sink path. Needs a pull-up if used (value not stated).

specs-o.pdo_straps_note-s: one entry per pin and resistor: a divider is two entries (RUP to LDO_3V3, RDOWN to GND); a decoded 0 / 5 / 7 is a single tie (GND / LDO_1V5 / LDO_3V3). 5 V alone is not settable: ADCIN2 has no 5 V setting (Table 8-5); the lowest window is 5-9 V (ADCIN1 0, ADCIN2 1). The 12 / 15 V entries keep TI's printed 162 k / 38 k pair (decoded 3); 38 k is not an E96 value (38.3 k keeps 0.191, inside 0.1425-0.2372).
specs-o.sink_current_strap-s: ADCIN3 decoded 2 + ADCIN4 decoded 1 = 2 A operating / 3 A maximum (Table 8-6 p37)
specs-o.iout_max_note-s: VBUS_IN to PPHV 7 A continuous at TA <= 45 C, 6 A at TA <= 65 C (6.3.1 p9); PD request up to 5 A (Table 8-6)
specs-o.vbus_note-s: ROC 4-22 V (6.3.1 p9); abs max 28 V on VBUS_IN / VBUS / PPHV (6.1 p8, note 4: a TVS breaking down between 22 V and 28 V, such as TVS2200, is recommended)
specs-o.cc_rd_note-s: integrated Rd: RSNK 4.1-6.1 kohm (6.11 p15), dead-battery Rd included (Features p1): no external 5.1 k
specs-o.cpphv_uf: nom 47, max 100 at 25 V rating (6.4 p10; USB PD cSnkBulkPd 100 uF max total on the sink after a contract, which includes the buck's input caps); Figure 9-3 lays 22 + 22 + 10 uF
specs-o.ccc_pf: 200 / 400 / 480 per CC pin incl. all capacitance to the receptacle, 6.3 V rating (6.4 p10); Figure 9-3: 330 pF
specs-o.schottky_note-s: TI recommends a Schottky diode from VBUS to ground against cable-inductance ground currents at sudden disconnect (8.5 p39); part not named
specs-o.layout_note-s: CC caps on the same side as the part, no via between CC pin and cap (9.4.1.3 p49); VBUS >= 6 vias, VBUS_IN and PPHV 15 vias each, 8 mil hole / 16 mil pad (9.4.1.4 p49); DRAIN pads unconnected

not_stated-o.fault_in_pullup-s: FAULT_IN's level when left floating is not stated; held high here per its pin description
not_stated-o.dead_battery-s: 8.3.2 says the VIN_3V3 switch stays open until a host clears the dead-battery flag over I2C; standalone operation runs from the VBUS LDO, as the Description p1 ('no need for ... an external microcontroller') and Figures 9-1/9-2 (VIN_3V3 optional) intend

specs-o.ambient_note-s: TA -40 to 65 C with IPP_HV <= 6 A, to 45 C at 7 A (6.3.1 p9)
specs-o.on-resistance_note-s: VBUS_IN -> PPHV, IPPHV 6.5 A (6.8 RPPHV p12): typ 16 / max 19 mohm at TJ_PPHV 25 C, 24 / 29 at 125 C, 27 / 32 at 150 C; the max field holds the worst stated max (150 C, the switch's operating TJ limit)

component-o.sku-note-s: Strap setting of the TPS25730DREFR: 9 V fixed PDO (ADCIN1 = ADCIN2 = decoded 1, 178 k / 9.53 k each), 2 A operating / 3 A maximum (ADCIN3 decoded 2 178 k / 21.5 k, ADCIN4 decoded 1 178 k / 9.53 k), standalone (I2C grounded, no VIN_3V3 supply), FAULT_IN held high. Made for the USB-C 9 V -> 7 V / 2 A supply (architect request, 2026-10-26). Other PDOs: specs-o pdo_straps-ao. Strap resistors: RC0402FR-07178KL, RC0402FR-079K53L, RC0402FR-0721K5L (all in ltl.db, stocked).
